violation_type.title: Activities for Infants - Provide Large Muscle Development (26 TAC §746.2417(8))
violation_type.short_title: Activities for Infants - Provide Large Muscle Development
violation_type.typical_finding: Observed the Sit-Up Support Ring being used by an 5 month old infant as a tummy time support pillow.     This was corrected when the caregiver removed the Sit-Up support ring from the infant's chest.

finding_variants.text: Observed the Sit-Up Support Ring being used by an 5 month old infant as a tummy time support pillow.     This was corrected when the caregiver removed the Sit-Up support ring from the infant's chest.

A caregiver placed a three-month-old child in a stationary jumper; the child cannot yet support himself in the upright position therefore this is not an age appropriate activity or age appropriate equipment.
